verification.note: Traced through the code. useMediaControlsState.ts:262-270: noteSkip on touch sets bottomOnly=true and controlsVisible=true. It changes none of the deps of the effect at 222-234, so bottom-only survives while paused, and the test at watchedBand.visibility.test.tsx:347-353 confirms this ('bottom-only' while paused). A touch pointerdown on the seek slider calls onScrubStart, which is state.beginScrub (MediaControlsContainer.tsx:314 -> SeekBar.tsx:141). beginScrub (279-282) calls setScrubTime, so scrubbing flips to true. The effect at 222-234, whose deps include scrubbing, re-runs and line 223 `if (paused || holdVisible) setBottomOnly(false)` clears bottom-only because paused is true. controlsVisible is already true, so TouchControlsPresenter.tsx:63 computes whole = visible && !bottomOnly = true: the centre play button and the top-right buttons appear and take touches mid-scrub. On scrub end, endScrub (297) skips restartSkipWindow because bottomOnlyRef is now false, so the 2 s window is not restarted either. Nothing on the coarse-pointer path counters this, because the frame's pointerdown reveal is skipped for coarse pointers (MediaControlsContainer.tsx:128). The paused-transition effect at 238-242 already ends bottom-only on pause and resume, so the paused term at line 223 only matters on unrelated re-runs like this one. The existing test 'a scrub started in bottom-only stays there...' (watchedBand.visibility.test.tsx:406-430) calls touchPage() with no paused option, so it covers only the playing case. This contradicts I5: the scrub should keep bottom-only, and the chrome should become whole only 2 s after the scrub ends.

specification_compliance: I5: in the touch layout, a scrub started from bottom-only while paused turns the chrome whole at scrub start, through useMediaControlsState.ts:223 (R1 confirmed).
regression_risks: A fix that drops `paused` from line 223 must keep the pause and resume transitions clearing bottom-only; the effect at 238-242 handles those.
test_coverage: watchedBand.visibility.test.tsx covers a scrub in bottom-only only while playing; there is no paused variant.
